label: TP
reason: The user-supplied header value flows directly into the HTML output via concatenation without being sanitized. Although HtmlUtils.htmlEscape is called on line 98, the CodeQL report indicates the vulnerable paths involve getValue() and getName() which bypass the escaping logic entirely, leading to unescaped user content in the response.

evidence.note: User input from Header and Cookie name flows to response.getWriter() without proper sanitization despite htmlEscape call
